professionalSummary.text: Complaints handler with three years of experience in a retail bank's complaints team, investigating approximately 400 complaints annually against account records under the team's investigation procedure.
professionalSummary.witness: Complaints handler in a retail bank's complaints team for three years, investigating about four hundred complaints a year against the account records under the team's investigation procedure.

professionalSummary.text: Achieved consistent quality in phone conversations with customers, as evidenced by quarterly call monitoring scorecards that scored all calls within the call standard for three years.
professionalSummary.witness: Handled the phone conversations on each case, including the escalated calls the branch network passed to the team; the quality checkers' call monitoring scored my calls within the call standard in every quarter of the three years, with the scorecards in the quality folder.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote final response letters under the team's letter standard, with 96% issued within the regulator's time limit over the three-year period.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the final response letters under the team's letter standard, with ninety-six per cent issued within the regulator's time limit over the period.

professionalSummary.text: Agreed redress within delegated limits and referred cases exceeding limits to the team leader, documenting referrals and limits on each case.
professionalSummary.witness: Agreed redress within my delegated limit and referred the cases above it to the team leader, recording the referral and the limit on each case.

professionalSummary.text: Documented open items and hand-over conditions for all cases passed to other handlers or quality checkers.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions on each case passed to another handler or to the quality checkers.
